cohort: Adult female participants presenting to the emergency department with dyspnea or to the obstetrics and gynecology department for a scheduled cesarean section.
finding: YOLO-based models (v5n6, v8n, v10n) demonstrated high accuracy in detecting and localizing cricoid cartilage and thyroid cartilage, with YOLOv8n and YOLOv10n achieving clinically acceptable real-time imaging performance when deployed on a wireless handheld ultrasound device with an edge computing tablet.
cross-section timing: Data collected between August 2022 and July 2024.
